payload.entry:
Corrected athena readout after host-evidence handoff classification (checkout implementing plan:202610/e3_live_verification_defects.md). Host: athena. Generated 2026-10-15T10:50Z.

Claude miss rates (non-research):
- Pre-cutover 2026-09-10T00:00:00Z..2026-10-05T00:00:00Z, mode none: ≤2/777 (0%)
- Mid 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z..2026-10-14T10:35:06Z, mode legacy: ≤0/110 (0%)
- Post-cutover since 2026-10-14T10:35:00Z, mode explicit: ≤0/9 (0%)

The sase-1ko baseline attachments (notes #5, #6, #12, #13) predate this fix and overcount misses for providers whose final handoff call is not recorded in tool_calls.jsonl. Claude records that call, so its rates moved little. Three JSON files of the corrected windows are attached to sase-1kt. Flag state unchanged.
